text: でかいゴミの　ことかな？

structure.jp: でかいゴミの　ことかな？
structure.en: does it mean a huge piece of garbage, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.span: でかいゴミの　こと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a thing word means 'the thing meant is', used when saying what a word refers to. でかいゴミの　こと = 'it means big garbage'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', a guess to yourself. ことかな = 'is that what it means, maybe?'
